response.overview: Charles Haycock's first stand up special was filmed at The Good Times Comedy Club in Lethbridge Canada. Music includes: Rossini - William Tell Overture (licensed from classicals.de) Charles drops hard hitting takes on the alphabet, puzzle glue, even yoga pants. His intricate analysis of the unfortunate patrons of Walmart will have you signing up for therapy. Seeing the world through the lens of Charles Haycock is crippling for him, but super funny for you!
